title: When device is in MTP or PTP mode, only show actions relevant to that mode
line: Phones connected in MTP mode no longer offer camera actions like "Download Photos with Gwenview" or digiKam that always failed.
explanation: Android phones in MTP mode get both Solid's PortableMediaPlayer (mtp) and Camera (gphoto) interfaces from the libmtp and libgphoto2 udev data, so Disks & Devices offered every gphoto camera action (Gwenview's and digiKam's "Download Photos", Kamera's camera:/ browser). kio-extras' kmtpd opens every MTP player, so gphoto can't claim the USB device and those actions fail with "Could not claim the USB device", as in the reporter's screenshots. The applet now skips, for devices whose media player interface supports mtp, any action whose Solid predicate uses the Camera interface but not PortableMediaPlayer; real PTP cameras and storage devices keep all their actions.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: Hide camera actions for MTP devices

Phones in MTP mode also show up as gphoto cameras, but kio-mtp keeps
them claimed, so camera actions like downloading photos with Gwenview
or digiKam always failed. Don't offer actions that only use the camera.

BUG: 446274

media.caption: Pixel 7 in MTP mode offers digiKam and Gwenview photo downloads, which can't work
Pixel 7 only has Open in File Manager; the PTP camera still offers both downloads

reviews.text: Well-targeted fix in ActionsInfo::updateActionsForPredicates() that filters out Camera-only Solid actions for MTP devices claimed by kio-mtp, removing broken gphoto actions while leaving PTP cameras and USB storage untouched. Doing this in the devicenotifier applet is the right layer since Solid::Predicate cannot express negation in individual apps' desktop files, and the before/after evidence confirms the fix cleanly.

Filtering, for MTP-capable devices, any action whose predicate targets only the Camera interface removes all three failing actions from the report (Gwenview, digiKam, Kamera's camera:/ browser) generically in the applet, which is cleaner than patching three apps' action files as Nate suggested. The PTP half already holds: PTP cameras have no StorageAccess, so no Mount, and their default 'Open in File Manager' is solid_camera, which works; Pixel PTP-mode ids are indeed also in 69-libmtp.hwdb, so kmtpd claims them and hiding the camera actions there is honest. Code is small and safe (Predicate::usedTypes, null-checked as<>), the screenshots match the captions, and the commit message matches the diff. Verification relies on SOLID_FAKEHW rather than a real phone, which is a fair rig limit.
